canonical_mechanism: delegated local decisions under umbrella authority
same_or_different: Different implementations/procedures, shared target-mechanism family; not the same product.
reason: Neither read body establishes both exact C1 and excluded-repository C2. CNCF federation still has umbrella escalation.
separating_input: An excluded repository disputes a decision: a federation may escalate it to the umbrella; true external stewardship must leave it outside.
control_input: Every repository explicitly joins the umbrella and accepts escalation.

same_or_different: Related admission-gate principle; Jupyter external incubation and FINOS transfer modes are distinct procedures.
reason: A's explicit integration criterion is incomplete evidence for standards/protocol strategy; FINOS does not specify excluded-subset stewardship. No additional qualified C mechanism.
separating_input: A repository is in the proposed subset but fails the admission criterion; gated transfer defers while immediate group-wide transfer moves it.
control_input: The only proposed repository passes every admission criterion.

canonical_mechanism: explicit receiver acceptance while outgoing accountability remains
same_or_different: Three related vendor articles, conservatively one independent guidance family.
reason: A useful acceptance-check hypothesis, but no original Jupyter alignment rule and all visible dates are after 2024.
separating_input: Technical access changes but receiving maintainers do not accept responsibility.
control_input: Access change and authorized governance acceptance both complete.

same_or_different: Same product and document lineage, versions 2021/2025.
reason: Geometric location and group locks do not represent repository or human authority.
separating_input: A locked group's member moves while administrative authority remains unchanged.

canonical_mechanism: move removes prior membership; copy retains it
same_or_different: Separate implementation from Netfabb; similar parts/group words but distinct catalog semantics.
reason: Catalog membership is not a governance boundary.
separating_input: Copy a shape to a second group: both memberships remain, whereas moving removes the first.
control_input: Inspect only geometry after either operation: unchanged geometry can look the same.

canonical_mechanism: role classification by actual sustained support
same_or_different: A reproduced guidance page and related FAQ views; not three independent original legal instruments.
reason: Underlying primary law/guidance not opened, and legal stewardship cannot be equated to the proposal's voluntary governance boundary.
separating_input: A repo is declared outside an umbrella but the umbrella systematically supports it; the word stewardship alone does not settle either role.
control_input: Responsibility declaration and actual support scope coincide.

same_or_different: Only mirror body opened; canonical original pending.
reason: Primary authenticity and excluded-repository boundary unverified.

same_or_different: Already named by selected proposal; baseline, not a discovered alternative.
reason: Index body does not establish exact transfer criteria or excluded scope.
separating_input: Older website and governing compass conflict.
